node.statement: Differentiated coordinate identity: for xi in icalH set P=DF_s(A)xi and R=DQ(A)xi. Differentiating the exact full factorization gives -xi+DG(A)xi=P+DG(B)P+R+E, where E=(P+DG(B)P) bold-dot Q+(B+G(B)) bold-dot R. Hermitian/anti-Hermitian typing gives P+xi=-P^parallel(E) and R=DG(A)xi-DG(B)P-P^perp(E). By the local graph estimate in the second step at ||A||<=r and ||B||<=2r, ||DG(A)||,||DG(B)||<=K_g*r.
